data.narrative:
DG Matrix is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Haroon Inam and Subhashish Bhattacharya that has raised $100M+ to date. The valuation framework draws on a peer universe of 9 companies operating in the climate and energy sector—1 public (LNZA) and 8 private entities including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression analysis was the primary applicable method. Using the $100M total capital raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, this approach implies a valuation of $200M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable; while 8 same-sector comparables exist, insufficient datapoints met narrow stage and valuation-tier filters (fewer than the required 3 comps), making sector-wide medians unreliable without introducing selection bias.

The triangulated valuation range is $170M–$230M, with a median of $200M. This single-method range reflects material dependence on the step-up multiplier assumption and the $100M raised-to-date proxy. Key uncertainties include the absence of tightly comparable Series A financials in climate tech, sensitivity to the 2.0x advancement multiplier, and limited visibility into DG Matrix's revenue, unit economics, or capital efficiency relative to stated peer set. Additional disclosure of revenue or path-to-profitability metrics would materially narrow this range.
